title: Stable Matchings and Their Histories: Historical Reachability under Population Shocks
abstract: arXiv:2609.20176v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Sequential-entry procedures need not reach every stable matching. We ask whether full reachability is restored when agents on both sides may enter and exit repeatedly, with proposal-chain restabilization after each population change. It is not: a three-by-three marriage market has a stable matching that is unreachable from the empty active market along any such history restricted to terminal agents.   We then allow temporary historical agents who are absent at the terminal date. For every target stable matching, we construct a target-dependent, preference-preserving augmentation and an admissible history that reaches it, with all temporary agents exiting before termination. The construction extends to many-to-one markets with responsive hospital preferences.   Thus reachability depends on the admissible history class. Terminal-agent histories may select a proper subset of the stable set, whereas preference-preserving augmented histories

translated_title: 稳定匹配及其历史：人口冲击下的历史可达性
translated_abstract: 序贯进入程序未必能到达每一个稳定匹配。我们研究当市场两侧的行为人可以反复进入和退出、且每次人口变动后通过提议链进行重新稳定化时，是否能够恢复完全可达性。答案是否定的：在一个三对三的婚姻市场中，存在一个稳定匹配，在仅限于终端行为人的任何此类历史下，都无法从空的活跃市场出发到达。随后，我们引入了在终端日期不再存在的临时历史行为人。对于每一个目标稳定匹配，我们构造了一个依赖目标的、保持偏好的增广以及一条能够到达该匹配的容许历史，且所有临时行为人都在终止之前退出。该构造可推广至具有响应性医院偏好的多对一市场。因此，可达性取决于所容许的历史类别：终端行为人历史可能只选取稳定集的一个真子集，而保持偏好的增广历史则可以到达完整稳定集。
tldr: 该论文证明即使在双方均可反复进出且每次变动后重新稳定化的市场中，仅凭终端行为人的历史仍无法到达所有稳定匹配，但通过引入保持偏好的临时行为人增广，可为任意目标稳定匹配构造出可达的容许历史。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that histories restricted to terminal agents cannot reach every stable matching even under repeated two-sided entry and exit, but by introducing preference-preserving temporary agent augmentations, an admissible history can be constructed to reach any target stable matching.
